title: Competing interpretations in ambiguous identifiers
description: Tracks whether alternative semantic worlds appear, disappear or remain readable before a surface interpretation is selected.

hypothesis.primary: Ambiguous prompts transiently support multiple interpretation families before one becomes dominant.
falsifiers: Only the final interpretation is readable at every eligible depth.
Candidate losing worlds are no more frequent than the preregistered early-layer reference distribution.
exploratory: Identify the last layer at which a losing interpretation remains readable.

chat.content: I found a product labeled Aurora 12B. Explain what it is and how I should maintain it.
I found an AI model release labeled Aurora 12B. Explain what it is and how I should maintain its deployment.
I found an industrial machine labeled Aurora 12B. Explain what it is and how I should maintain the equipment.

exclusions: Byte-identical duplicate results beyond the first observation
analysis.notes: This protocol observes readability only; it does not establish causal competition.

stopping_rule: Complete all conditions and retain null results.
